specs.title: isolated UI: blind submission hides answers and removes locked controls after reload
F5 keeps selection without scrolling to a control or starting work
employee, dossier, control and source-run context survive navigation, reload and back
admin: navigation, scope and safe exports
ledangkhoa: navigation, scope and safe exports
ledoanvantu: navigation, scope and safe exports
notifications: unread filter and persisted-read UI do not mutate remediation or assessment
corrective action UI: baseline, consultant approval, assigned work and separate verification without main writes
batch UI: rejects stale start, follows running batch across reload and stops without losing results
candidate UI: invalid JSON, server refusal, receipt, changed engine and concurrent run
